android.desc:
MNML Launcher - Your Minimalist Android Home Screen

Transform your Android home screen into a clean, distraction-free experience with MNML Launcher. Designed for users who want simplicity without sacrificing functionality.

🏠 **Key Features:**

**Customizable Layout**
• Two rows of app slots for organized access to your favorite apps
• Drag and drop to reorder apps exactly how you want them
• Add or remove slots to match your workflow

**Personalization**
• Custom app labels and Material Design icons
• Choose from hundreds of Material Symbols for unique app shortcuts
• Dark mode support for comfortable viewing
• Adjustable clock and battery display options

**Gesture Controls**
• Configure swipe left/right actions for quick access
• Launch specific apps, dialer, or widgets with simple gestures

**Privacy-First Design**
• No data collection or internet connectivity required
• All settings stored locally on your device
• Zero tracking or analytics - your privacy is respected

**AccessibilityService Disclosure**
• MNML uses the AccessibilityService permission only to enable the Double Tap to Lock feature.
• This service allows the app to detect a double tap gesture and turn off the screen for your convenience.
• The AccessibilityService is optional, used solely for this feature, and does not collect or share any user data.
• MNML does not change any system settings or perform actions without your consent.

**Backup & Restore**
• Export and import your settings and layout
• Never lose your customizations when switching devices

MNML Launcher focuses on what matters most - quick, easy access to your apps in a clean, minimalist interface. No bloat, no distractions, just pure functionality.

Perfect for users who want a streamlined Android experience that puts their apps front and center.

📱 Requires Android 8.0 or higher
🔒 Minimal permissions - only vibrate and delete packages for basic functionality

quotes.text:
Just got the first open testing release approved on google play store for a minimal android launcher i'm developing.

I recently switched to a phone with an e-ink display and was missing features in current minimal launchers, so i decided to make my own.

Would love to hear your opinion, improvements that could be made or features to change/add.

Thanks!

=== Links ===

    - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kolktech.mnml
    - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6gcF9lSDBPY (video demo)

=== Current Features ===

    - Multiple rows of apps
    - Material Font icons can be set as app names
    - When reducing or increasing apps you can re-order and select which apps to keep (this is missing from a lot of minimal launchers imo)
    - App shortcuts (long press on an app to show that app's own shortcut menu)
    - Backup your launcher settings with Export/Import
    - App drawer list (swipe up)
    - You can hide apps from the app list
    - You can uninstall apps from the app list
    - App rows can have their size individually set.

=== Planned features ===

    - Background images or static colors
    - Show weather information
    - Screen time usage information
    - Possibly some limited widgets
        - google search bar on the bottom?      
        - Notes on the main screen  
    - App folders (so you can assign multiple apps to one slot)
    - App slot assignment other than apps
        - URL's
        - Files
        - Intents
        - Contacts
       …
